info.title: GenderAPI.io Universal API
info.description: Infer gender and validate phone numbers from names, emails, and usernames

get.description: Retrieves gender details from GenderAPI.io by email address.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email address to analyze.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to improve prediction accuracy.

schema.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to improve prediction accuracy.

parameters.name: askToAI
parameters.description: Ask GenderAPI's AI model when the name extracted from the email is not found in the database.

schema.description: Ask GenderAPI's AI model when the name extracted from the email is not found in the database.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

name.description: The found or extracted first name.

remaining_credits.description: The number of credits remaining after the request.

total_names.description: The number of samples behind the prediction.

used_credits.description: The number of credits used for the request.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves gender details from GenderAPI.io for multiple email addresses.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Array of email records to analyze. Each object can include email, country, and id.

schema.description: Array of email records to analyze. Each object can include email, country, and id.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

names.description: Array of gender results for each submitted email record.

remaining_credits.description: The number of credits remaining after the request.

status.description: Whether the batch request was successful.

used_credits.description: The number of credits used for the batch request.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves phone validation details from GenderAPI.io.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: The phone number to validate in E.164, national, or international format.

schema.description: The phone number to validate in E.164, national, or international format.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Optional country, region, or city hint used when the number does not include an international country code.

schema.description: Optional country, region, or city hint used when the number does not include an international country code.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

isGeographical.description: Whether the number is tied to a geographic area.

isPossible.description: Whether the number could exist structurally.

remaining_credits.description: The number of credits remaining after the request.
